RSVP Status

  • CURIE: gmeow:RsvpStatus
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RsvpStatus
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/calendar

The RSVP response status as asserted by an invitee — a VALUE vocabulary, distinct from InvitationStatus so that organizer and invitee claims can coexist (Principle 9).

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:RsvpStatus as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
